name: Docker Hub Description
description: An action to update a Docker Hub repository description from README.md

password.description: Docker Hub password or Personal Access Token with read/write/delete scope

repository.description: Docker Hub repository in the format `<namespace>/<name>` Default: `github.repository`

readme-filepath.description: Path to the repository readme Default: `./README.md`

enable-url-completion.description: Enables completion of relative URLs to absolute ones Default: `false`

image-extensions.description: File extensions that will be treated as images Default: `bmp,gif,jpg,jpeg,png,svg,webp`
